tier1_postgresql.purpose: real multi-connection transactional acceptance, owner authority, ambiguity, generation-bound owner-current history reconciliation, physical PITR, surviving-authority recovery evidence and Tier 1 relocation activation authority

tier2_timescale.purpose: candidate tenant isolation, background jobs, fresh-cluster restore, target-owned key generation/checkpoint/freeze authority, cross-authority activation verification and bounded capacity falsification

classification_basis.final_package_gate_requirement: The exact final package HEAD, including reviewer documentation, must independently rerun both gates before review or acceptance.
classification_basis.note: The executable anchor proves owner-controlled source/poll authority; owner-derived history finality/currentness whose coverage is bound to the exact current authority generation and invalidated on every generation transition even when timestamps remain equal; rejection of conflicting owner-visible canonical content under an already accepted reconciliation identity before any coverage run is minted; surviving external authenticated PITR recovery grants; genuine fresh-cluster Timescale reconstruction; lock-before-F source fencing; deterministic self-delimiting structured cryptographic representations; target-owned checkpoint signing authority whose effective key is generated inside Tier 2 and is neither provisioned nor retained by the cross-database test controller; Tier 1 verification without mint capability; restricted authority-owned verifier connection capability state with verifier secrets absent from function source; durable Tier 1 activation grants; target promotion only after exact grant verification; no uncheckpointed pre-activation target history; seal-vs-DML serialization; and atomic rollback of the Tier 1 placement+grant commit when a grant conflict is injected.

material_findings_closed_by_current_mech: conflicting canonical observation content under stable identity must reject
active source and poll authority must be resolved from owner-controlled state in the transaction
relocation source placement must be locked before deriving F
max(target)=F cannot prove complete target coverage
history completeness requires contiguous coverage from supported_history_floor
target activation must bind to current actual target state
relocation fingerprint must include immutable canonical payload
PITR admission must consume authenticated surviving (R,F] evidence rather than a locally self-minted receipt
history finality/currentness must be derived from durable owner/provider authority rather than worker-supplied timestamps
history reconciliation coverage must be bound to the exact current authority generation, not only snapshot timestamps
an authority-generation transition must invalidate prior materialized reconciliation coverage even when currentness timestamps are unchanged
conflicting owner-current provider content under an existing reconciled observation identity must reject before recording coverage
target rows above F before activation must be rejected or included in checkpoint authority
canonical relocation serialization must be self-delimiting so unrestricted text cannot collide with field or row framing
structured cryptographic evidence messages must be self-delimiting before HMAC; cryptographic integrity cannot repair ambiguous field framing
Tier 1 checkpoint verification must not hold the target signing key or equivalent mint capability
target automation must not transition sealed to activated before exact Tier 1 cutover authority exists
Tier 1 placement activation and durable activation-grant creation must be all-or-nothing under mid-commit failure
target-only key authority requires the effective signing key to originate inside target authority rather than being generated or retained by a cross-authority controller
cross-authority verifier credentials must not be embedded in SQL function source and must remain restricted authority capability state
native_assurance_panorama_extensions: durable live poll claim required for current-state candidacy
reconciliation snapshot currentness required in addition to interval geometry
reconciliation_run eligibility requires exact equality with locked current authority_generation
advance_provider_authority clears materialized coverage and forces non-gap reconciliation_required even on same-timestamp generation changes
same-snapshot authority-generation bump cannot reuse previous-generation coverage and requires a fresh current-generation sweep
reconciled stable identity with changed observed_at or numeric_value aborts the sweep, preserves accepted canonical content and creates no reconciliation_run
recovery grant stored as structured typed fields and independently read without shell delimiter parsing
recovery receipt contains a literal pipe in the positive vector without changing authority boundaries
target checkpoint HMAC uses the same cross-store canonical field encoding as its digest
target checkpoint signing key exists only in target authority and Tier 1 contains no target signing-key relation
effective target signing key is generated inside Tier 2 target authority using target-side randomness
cross-database test controller does not provision or retain the effective target signing key
projection writer and target verifier cannot read the generated target signing key
target verifier principal cannot read target signing key and Tier 1 verifier principal cannot read activation-grant or placement tables
target and Tier 1 verifier connection capabilities are stored in restricted authority-owned state
verifier and automation principals cannot read cross-authority connection capability state
random verifier secrets are absent from verifier SQL function source
Tier 1 forged checkpoint attestation is rejected by target authority
target self-activation before Tier 1 grant is rejected and sealed future-write protection remains active
Tier 1 activation grant binds tenant, F, checkpoint id/generation, target attestation and successor placement version
cross-authority verification is bounded and performed before local authority locks; post-verification work is local transactional/CAS only
grant-conflict fault injection proves placement rolls back and target remains sealed
seal serializes against target DML before measuring checkpoint set
freeze protects cross-tenant identity and the full sealed pre-activation target state
activated target history through F remains immutable while only post-F append is eligible
projection writer cannot disable target freeze
Timescale LOGIN automation owner is explicitly a cross-tenant privileged infrastructure principal; PASSWORD NULL is not NOLOGIN or production admission proof

late_history_evidence.worker: history_reconcile_worker NOLOGIN with EXECUTE only on sweep/finalize
late_history_evidence.sweep_authority: worker supplies only window plus expected authority generation; actual generation and provider snapshot are read and locked from provider_authority
late_history_evidence.finalization_authority: try_finalize accepts no caller authority/finality/currentness values; it reads and locks current authority_generation, finality and required snapshot from provider_authority
late_history_evidence.stale_worker: rejected when expected generation differs from durable current authority
late_history_evidence.coverage_generation: only reconciliation_run rows whose authority_generation equals the exact currently locked owner generation are eligible
late_history_evidence.generation_transition: every authority-generation advance clears materialized coverage and moves non-gap state to reconciliation_required even if snapshot/finality/currentness timestamps are unchanged
late_history_evidence.coverage_semantics: only overlapping/touching runs from the exact current authority generation whose durable provider_snapshot_at satisfies owner-required currentness form continuous coverage
late_history_evidence.stable_identity_content: existing accepted (stream_id,observation_id) content is immutable; owner-visible observed_at or numeric_value mismatch rejects the sweep before a reconciliation_run is recorded
late_history_evidence.conflict_failure_atomicity: rejected conflicting sweep preserves accepted canonical content and does not mint coverage
late_history_evidence.same_timestamp_generation_negative: generation 3 reuses generation 2 timestamps but cannot reuse generation 2 coverage; a fresh generation 3 sweep is required before finalization
late_history_evidence.unrecoverable_retention_loss: explicit durable gap; never false complete

recovery_evidence.restore_boundary: physical PostgreSQL PITR to committed R
recovery_evidence.surviving_authority: separate external control PostgreSQL not included in source backup/restore
recovery_evidence.grant_storage: structured typed columns: domain, R, F, successor epoch, placement version, required receipt, nonce, canonical payload, attestation
recovery_evidence.grant_canonical_field_encoding: UTF-8 byte length in decimal + ':' + lowercase UTF-8 hex
recovery_evidence.grant_canonicalization: all structured fields are independently self-delimiting before HMAC-SHA-256
recovery_evidence.grant_authentication: HMAC-SHA-256 with random key stored only in surviving external authority
recovery_evidence.delimiter_collision_negative: legacy pipe framing admits ambiguous logical field boundaries; the self-delimiting encoding distinguishes them
recovery_evidence.successful_admission: requires reconciled local R state plus fresh successful verification of the surviving externally held structured canonical grant

relocation_evidence.source_fence_derivation: placement authority locked before F is derived
relocation_evidence.source_inflight_acceptance_race: acceptance holding placement lock commits before fence and is included in F
relocation_evidence.canonical_field_encoding: UTF-8 byte length in decimal + ':' + lowercase UTF-8 hex
relocation_evidence.canonical_serialization: ordered rows; every field self-delimiting; row concatenation uses no delimiter as an authority boundary
relocation_evidence.cross_store_encoding: PostgreSQL and Timescale produce identical canonical_field output for text containing literal 0x1f/0x1e control bytes
relocation_evidence.canonical_payload_fingerprint: SHA-256 over deterministic self-delimiting canonical observation serialization
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation_payload: domain, tenant, F, checkpoint id, generation, sealed flag, target count, target digest and target max are independently canonical_field encoded before HMAC
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation_cross_store: Tier 1 canonicalizer and Timescale issuer produce identical canonical_checkpoint_payload for the same facts
relocation_evidence.projection_writer: ts_automation_owner with projection DML but without checkpoint/key ownership or freeze-disable authority
relocation_evidence.target_signing_key_generation: generated inside Tier 2 target authority using target-side randomness
relocation_evidence.target_verifier_capability: yes/no SECURITY DEFINER verification only; verifier cannot read signing key or target connection capability state
relocation_evidence.tier1_verifier_capability: yes/no SECURITY DEFINER activation-grant verification only; verifier cannot read grant/placement tables or Tier 1 connection capability state
relocation_evidence.target_connection_capability_store: restricted target-authority-owned state; target verifier cannot read
relocation_evidence.tier1_connection_capability_store: restricted Tier1-authority-owned state; projection writer and target verifier cannot read
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation: domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 over self-delimiting target-owned checkpoint facts
relocation_evidence.preseal_future_row: any target row accepted_ordinal > F makes sealing fail and leaves control phase open
relocation_evidence.sealed_phase: all target-history DML for the relocating tenant is rejected and target self-activation without a Tier 1 grant returns false
relocation_evidence.tier1_activation_commit: placement transition and exact activation grant are committed in one local PostgreSQL transaction; conflict raises and rolls both back
relocation_evidence.activation_conflict_fault_injection: duplicate grant conflict after placement UPDATE path proves fenced placement survives, injected grant cannot activate target and target remains sealed
relocation_evidence.target_activation_authority: target verifies exact committed Tier 1 grant and matching active placement before sealed-to-activated transition
relocation_evidence.cross_authority_call_order: remote verification occurs before local authority locks; after verification each authority performs short local transactional/CAS work only
relocation_evidence.cross_authority_failure_semantics: bounded verifier failure or uncertainty returns false/fail-closed
relocation_evidence.evidence_verifier_transport: PostgreSQL dblink plus random LOGIN verifier credentials with bounded connection/statement timeouts and restricted authority-owned connection capability stores
relocation_evidence.activated_phase: existing history is immutable; INSERT is eligible only above the relocation fence
relocation_evidence.seal_dml_serialization: target DML takes target_control shared authority; seal takes exclusive authority before future-row check and digest

crypto_evidence_boundary.rule: every structured message protected by hash/HMAC must first have deterministic versioned injective or equivalently unambiguous field framing; cryptographic integrity is not a substitute for canonical structure
crypto_evidence_boundary.canonical_encoding: bounded evidence representation using UTF-8 byte-length plus lowercase hex for observation payload fields, recovery-grant fields and checkpoint-attestation fields
crypto_evidence_boundary.target_checkpoint_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence integrity mechanism over canonical_checkpoint_payload with effective key generated and retained inside target authority
crypto_evidence_boundary.recovery_grant_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence integrity mechanism over canonical_grant
crypto_evidence_boundary.issuer_verifier_separation: verification capability does not include signing/mint capability; Tier 1 has no target signing key; cross-authority controller does not provision or retain the target key
crypto_evidence_boundary.verifier_secret_isolation: evidence verifier secrets are restricted authority capability state and are absent from SQL function source
crypto_evidence_boundary.production_requirement: accepted implementation may use equivalent encoding, crypto, verifier transport and secret storage only if independently reviewed evidence preserves deterministic versioning, unambiguous structured representation, target-originated target-only mint authority, verifier-without-mint capability, secret isolation from callable function source and unprivileged principals, bounded fail-closed verification outside local lock windows, exact activation-grant binding, atomic Tier 1 grant+placement commitment and key isolation

privileged_automation_boundary.production_requirement: database connection/authentication admission, pg_hba/socket/network exposure and role-membership policy must prevent tenant/application principals from authenticating as or assuming ts_automation_owner

bounded_capacity_observation.interpretation: Mechanism-level bounded fitness evidence only. Production SLOs, retention, cardinality, sizing, cost and topology remain OPEN-REL-020 C3.

decision_recommendation.tier1: accept PostgreSQL Tier 1 mechanism only with immutable canonical observation content, owner-controlled source/poll authority, durable live poll claims, owner-derived provider finality/currentness, contiguous generation-bound reconciliation, invalidation on authority-generation transition, rejection of conflicting canonical reconciled content under stable identity, structured self-delimiting authenticated surviving recovery grants after PITR, lock-before-F relocation fencing, target verification without mint authority, and atomic durable activation-grant plus placement commitment
decision_recommendation.tier2: accept TimescaleDB historical projection only under the mediated shared-history profile, privileged automation-owner admission boundary, genuine fresh-cluster role reconstruction, complete target checkpoint equivalence, target-originated target-only checkpoint signing authority, rejection of uncheckpointed target data before activation, target promotion only after exact Tier 1 activation-grant verification, immutable pre-F history after cutover, restricted verifier capability secrets, and cross-store self-delimiting checkpoint representations
rejected_assumptions: caller or worker supplied timestamps are not provider finality/currentness authority
same snapshot timestamp does not make reconciliation coverage valid across owner authority-generation changes
an existing reconciled observation identity with changed canonical content is not an idempotent duplicate
a locally recreated post-R receipt is not surviving (R,F] recovery authority
delimiter-parsed recovery payload text is not a structured cryptographic authority
target count/digest/max supplied by caller are not current target authority
identity-only digests are not canonical payload equivalence
delimiter-framed concatenation of unrestricted text is not an unambiguous canonical serialization
a strong hash or HMAC does not repair ambiguous pre-crypto structured serialization
a Tier 1 verifier that holds the target HMAC key is not independent target verification
a key stored only in the target database is not target-originated authority if a cross-authority controller generated, provisioned or retained the effective key
verifier credentials embedded in SQL function source are not acceptable capability-secret isolation
target automation cannot self-authorize sealed-to-activated without a committed Tier 1 activation grant
placement activation without an atomically committed exact activation grant is not valid successor authority
target rows above F may not exist invisibly before activation
PASSWORD NULL on a LOGIN role is not NOLOGIN or production connection-admission proof
same-cluster restore is not fresh role-topology recovery evidence
max(reconciliation window_to) is not contiguous history completeness
decision_recommendation.reversibility: Tier 2 remains behind the telemetry projection seam; replacement must preserve canonical observation identity/payload, deterministic versioned unambiguous structured serialization, idempotent projection, owner-derived currentness, exact-generation reconciliation coverage, authority-transition invalidation, stable-identity content immutability, externally surviving recovery authority, target-originated target-only mint/sign authority, verifier-without-mint capability, verifier-secret isolation, target checkpoint/freeze semantics, exact durable activation-grant binding, atomic placement+grant commitment, privileged-infrastructure boundaries, tenant isolation and relocation/recovery semantics
